verdicts.reason: A is just a scaled-down copy and was not reflowed for the tall canvas. The headline, body and CTA are small and pushed into the top half, leaving a large dead cream area above microscopic legal text, and the divider has drifted under the eyebrow. B breaks the brand: the logo was moved off the dark band, so the white SOLSTICE wordmark nearly vanishes on cream and the band is left empty. B also puts the 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow below the body copy, which breaks the reading order, leaves the divider orphaned and squeezes the legal text into an unreadable column. A at least keeps the brand and the reading order intact.
